recommendations.fix: Link a landing page where the dataset can be accessed.

recommendations.label: Persistent identifier
recommendations.fix: Declare a persistent identifier (DOI / Handle), not just a repository URL.

recommendations.label: Workflow language
recommendations.fix: Declare the workflow language (Python, Snakemake, Nextflow, …).

recommendations.label: Related links
recommendations.fix: Link related entities (datasets, publications) via typed relations.

recommendations.label: Access level
recommendations.fix: Declare the access level using a controlled vocabulary (open/restricted/embargoed).

recommendations.label: Data provenance (R3)
recommendations.fix: Record dataset identity, train/val/test splits, preprocessing, and evaluation results.

recommendations.label: Computational environment (R1)
recommendations.fix: Pin the environment: image digest (FROM …@sha256) and exact dependency versions.

recommendations.label: Methodological transparency (R2)
recommendations.fix: Declare random seeds, hyperparameters, and methods/algorithms.
